image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sliced bagel sandwich. The top half of the bagel is golden-brown with a visible central hole and small dark specks (likely seeds or bran). A slice of pale green cheese (possibly avocado-flavored or herb-infused) and a layer of brown meat or spread are visible between the halves. The sandwich rests on a white napkin atop a plate with blue and red stripes. A finger is partially visible holding the left edge of the bagel.

The object is unmistakably a bagel, adhering to the traditional ring format.
